artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.artist: Paulus Pontius after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: The image features a cow's head at the center with a draped cloth underneath bearing the text "Petrus Paulus Rubens delineavit." Above the cow's head, an owl is perched, and on either side, stacks of rectangular blocks resembling bricks are present. The color palette consists mainly of sepia tones. At the top center, crossed paintbrushes and palette knives are depicted, while on both sides, items like a painter's palette and a smoking flame can be seen. The composition appears symmetrical, with the cow's head and cloth at the center, the owl above, and the blocks flanking them on both sides, with a container overflowing with coins at the bottom.

artworks.title: Une Lecture (A Lecture)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a seated position from the waist up. Her head is tilted downward and to the side, with a bird perched on her shoulder. She has delicate facial features, a slightly rounded face, and hair styled back with a headscarf. She is wearing a high-waisted dress with puffed sleeves, adorned with decorative trim. Her hands rest on her lap, holding a partially closed book. A small piece of jewelry is visible on her wrist. Behind her is an ornate chair covered by a draped curtain. In the background, there is a large potted plant with intricate foliage against a wall, and a cloudy sky visible through what may be a window.

artworks.title: Frontispiece
artworks.description: A detailed drawing of an illustrated title page with Renaissance-era iconography and typical imagery found in early printed books. The image includes multiple sections filled with various panels featuring figures labeled 'Scotia,' 'Hibernia,' and 'Anglia,' scenes of royalty and battle, architectural structures, crowns, and figures within ornate frames. In the center, there is dense text introducing "Hakluytus Posthumus or Purchas his Pilgrimes," a compilation of travels and wonders of the world. The lower portion includes a world map split across two hemispheres, portraits, and additional text. The drawing depicts intricate details in hairstyles, clothing, and facial expressions of the figures.

artworks.title: Frontispiece
artworks.description: The image consists of different sections featuring various figures and elements. In the top left corner, two historical figures are depicted, one seated on a throne wearing robes and a crown, holding a scepter, and the other standing wearing a doublet and slops. The central and right sections show illustrations of a city labeled "New Jervsalem" and a bed with a reclining figure named "Elisabeth." Below, an interior scene shows a man seated at a desk with a book or tablet, surrounded by spinning globes and astronomical instruments. The background features maps labeled "Parssva Celvm" and "Geografia." At the bottom, a globe is shown with continents labeled "Asia," "Africa," "Americi," and "Terra del F.". The print also includes banners and scrolls with Latin text and extensive ornate detailing with celestial and terrestrial motifs.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a title page for a book. The full text prominently mentions "Samuel Purchas" and is entitled "Pelgrimagie, Gedeylt in twin tich Boecken," indicating it is written in Dutch. Below the title, there is an elaborate decorative element showcasing a mythological creature surrounded by ornate scrollwork. The text includes references to historical and mythological figures such as Bacchus, Hercules, and Ulysses. The bottom of the page indicates it was printed in Amsterdam by Jacob Benjamin in 1655.

artworks.title: La Vieille: Que Crains-tu? Un large trou Noir! Il est vide peut-etre? (What are you afraid of? A wide black hole! It is empty, perhaps!)
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the waist up, with their head slightly tilted downward and hands holding onto their cloak. The person's face is in shadow, making detailed facial features indistinguishable, but the eye and nose can be vaguely seen. The individual has long hair that is drawn down over each shoulder, and they appear to be wearing a headband that holds their long veil in place. Wrapped in a cloak or shroud that hangs loosely over their shoulders and partly covers their arms, the person is standing against a background filled with abstract, swirling patterns and textures, which create a dramatic contrast of light and dark areas around the figure.

artworks.title: Snub-Nosed Man in a Cap
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn and Studio of Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.description: The image is an ink drawing showing the upper part of a man's body in profile. He is facing right with his head slightly bowed, featuring a prominent nose and a long, full beard. His curly hair is mostly covered by a cap. He is wearing loosely sketched clothing possibly resembling a cloak. The drawing is done with bold lines and shading for texture. In the upper left corner, there is a signature "RH" and the date "1631." The background is plain with no additional details, highlighting the man's profile.

artworks.title: Lady with Green Hat (Mlle. Dieterle?)
artworks.medium: counterproof of pastel on thin Japanese paper mounted on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (Japanese paper): 58.9 × 47.3 cm (23 3/16 × 18 5/8 in.)
sheet (wove paper mount): 66.9 × 54.9 cm (26 5/16 × 21 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person positioned at a slight angle from the waist up, looking forward. The person has light skin, short wavy brown hair, and is wearing an ornate green hat that matches the hues of their outfit. They have a green shawl or collar over a dress with soft textures and pastel colors. The background is a muted mix of colors with no distinct objects.

artworks.title: Masonic Certificate
artworks.medium: engraving on wove paper, printed by Herbert Pasternack in 1954
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a Masonic certificate. The image features an intricate design with ornate columns on either side, topped by statues. At the top center, there is an illustration of a winged figure holding a ribbon overtaken by a celestial motif, including the sun and clouds. The body of the certificate contains elegant cursive script, with spaces left for names and specifics of the Masonic degree conferred. In the foreground at the bottom, a classical scene is depicted with figures and Masonic symbols such as a square, compass, and an open Bible on an altar with a globe resting on top. The detailed linework and shading give the drawing a formal and grandiose feel.

artworks.title: The Obelisk under the Liberty Tree, Boston
artworks.medium: engraving on wove paper, printed by Ed. O'Brien in 1973
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical monument. The drawing depicts four obelisks with inscriptions and images. Each obelisk is topped with portraits of notable figures and has scenes at the base. The obelisks stand on pedestals with descriptive text at the bottom. The scenes and inscriptions suggest themes of liberty and historical celebration.

artworks.title: Sir Jeffery Amherst
artworks.artist: Samuel William Reynolds I after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.description: The image shows a man in armor leaning forward, resting his chin on his hand with a sword. He has a star emblem on his chest. He has European features, short curled hair, and is standing next to a helmet. The background has a river, trees, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Bartholomew
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure bound to a tree, two other figures are present in the scene. One figure is manipulating ropes while the other observes. The drawing shows detailed musculature and expressions, set against a background of trees.

artworks.title: King Henry III
artworks.description: The image displays an upper body portrait of a man in an oval frame. He faces forward, looking slightly to his right. The man has a long face with defined features, a moustache, and medium-length curly hair. He is adorned with a crown featuring fleur-de-lis shapes, a robe with a fur-like pattern, and a high-collared garment. The background of the oval frame has a textured pattern, and the portrait is surrounded by decorative scrollwork. Below the portrait is a plaque inscribed with “K. HENRY II” and a scene of soldiers and horses in battle, encompassed by architectural elements.

artworks.title: Stag Hunt near a Pool
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Roelandt Savery
artworks.description: The image features a view at eye level into a densely detailed forest. The scene shows twisting tree trunks, canopies, roots, grasses, and a reflective pond. The artwork is rendered with intricate lines, cross-hatching, and a monochromatic color palette of black, white, and grey. The background fades to emphasize the detailed elements in the foreground.

artworks.title: Five Busts
artworks.description: The image consists of five side-profile portrait sketches of different individuals. In the top row, two adults are depicted. The woman on the left has her hair gathered back with curls around her face and is shown from the shoulders up, wearing a dress with puffed sleeves. Opposite her, the man to the right is drawn from slightly below the shoulders up, with short, curly hair and is dressed in a high-collared coat. The second row features two children, each with short hair and shown from the waist up. The child on the left has softer, chin-length hair with loose curls and wears a dress with a simple neckline. The child on the right has cropped hair and is clad in attire with a visible collar. At the bottom, there is a sketch of a young child with shoulder-length curly hair seen from the chest up, wearing a simple garment. The background is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the detailed linework of the portraits against the neutral backdrop.

artworks.title: Nude with Outstretched Arm
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a standing person in a relaxed pose. The person faces away from the viewer, showing the back of their body. The right arm is extended to the side, and the left arm hangs down. The head is slightly turned to the right. The person has an updo hairstyle. The figure is nude. The sketch is on a plain background with no surrounding objects. The image has a sepia-toned appearance.

artworks.title: Shepherd with Flock
artworks.description: The image features an elevated perspective overlooking a countryside scene with a shepherd and a flock of sheep. The horizon line is suggested by a light gradient, separating the sky from the landscape. The scene is depicted in a sketch-like style with detailed lines creating textures in the grass and foliage. The color palette consists of shades of brown and sepia, giving the image a vintage quality. Closest to us are patches of earth and grass, leading to the shepherd and his flock on a rise. The landscape recedes into the distance where a lone tree stands against the pale sky.

artworks.title: Etow oh Koam, King of the River Nation
artworks.artist: Pierre Simon II after John Verelst
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a relaxed pose with a staff. They have long, dark hair tied back, a distinctive tattoo on their forehead and cheek, loose-fitting clothing belted at the waist, moccasin-style footwear, a robe over their shoulders and a sheathed weapon hanging from their belt. Dense foliage and a turtle are around them. Two faint figures and more forest scenery are in the background.

artworks.title: King Richard I
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man. He is depicted from the chest up, facing forward with a serious expression. He has a long face, a pointed nose, and curly hair flowing around his neck. The man wears a crown with ornate designs and fleur-de-lis motifs, and he is dressed in armor on one shoulder with a draped cloak. Surrounding the portrait is an intricate circular frame. Below it is a plaque inscribed with "K. RICHARD I." In the background, there is a textured pattern, and below the plaque is a scene showing people interacting by a waterfront with ships and a castle in the background.

artworks.title: Mulld:Sake (Portrait of John Cottington)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in an exaggerated pose, holding two pipes emitting smoke. He has a mustached face, wears a feathered hat, and elaborate period clothing. The background features a cityscape with buildings emitting smoke.

artworks.title: Narcissus
artworks.artist: Robert T. Stothard after Thomas Stothard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures engaged in an activity. The figures are gathered closely, with one leaning forward as if to examine something on the ground. Each figure has distinct expressions and varied postures that suggest an interaction or shared moment. The scene is set in a forest-like environment, with trees surrounding the figures. Shadowing and detailed linework emphasize the depth, giving a three-dimensional effect to the figures and the scene. The attire of the individuals is classical. The composition and style evoke elegance and a sense of narrative captured in this monochromatic depiction.

artworks.title: Johannes Hoornbeeck
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the upper half of his body. The man is slightly turned to the right with his head facing the viewer in a three-quarter view. He has a mustache and short curly hair, wearing a dark cloak with ornate sleeves and a white collar. He is holding a closed book in his left hand. The background has a textured pattern with no distinct objects. At the bottom, text identifies the individual as "Ioannes Hoornbeeck."

artworks.title: Summer Evening (Soirée d'été)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a woman's body, reclining on a wicker chair or bench. She has her eyes closed and appears relaxed. She has curly hair and is wearing a detailed garment with a bow and floral decoration near the neckline, along with a dark scarf or shawl. Surrounding her is a body of water and lush greenery.

artworks.title: Cover, Yvette Guilbert
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person drawn in profile, capturing the upper half of the body. The person is standing with their head slightly tilted upward. Facial features include a nose and closed mouth, with short curly hair. The individual wears a garment, possibly with short sleeves. No accessories or objects are visible. The background is plain, with the text "Yvette Guilbert Drawn by H. de Toulouse Lautrec" around the sketch, and "Yvette Guilbert" as a signature beneath the drawing.
